text:
maria (security): CI scanner flagged sensitive credentials embedded in image layers pushed to our internal container registry (harbor). Looks like a docker/config.json with an auth token was cached into image layers by the legacy build cache. PLEASE DO NOT PULL/DEPLOY affected images.

maria (security): Immediate actions (do these now):
1) Infra/SRE: block reads from registry path projects/release/* for non-admins.
2) Infra: rotate any service-account keys used by CI and revoke registry tokens.
3) Owners: identify if any customer or infra workloads reference these images and plan redeploys.
4) Devs: disable legacy build cache in pipeline and open PR to fix pipeline config.

jake (infra): Ack. Pausing registry reads for non-admins and rotating CI SA keys now. Will push new creds to Vault and revoke old keys.

olivia (eng-releases): Pausing release jobs. Running full image inventory to list affected tags and owners. Will upload CSV shortly.

deploy-bot: registry-access: read blocked for group:devs on harbor.redwood.local at 2026-03-23T19:12:05Z

sam (sre): Forensics kick-off: pulling registry access logs, CI runner logs, and artifact metadata. Will identify which runner used legacy cache and return a list of commit SHAs.

maria (security): Sample revoke commands (use automation / Vault creds):
```
# list and delete SA keys (example)
gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=ci-pipeline@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com
gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete KEY_ID --iam-account=ci-pipeline@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```
Also rotate docker registry tokens via Harbor UI / API and delete affected tokens.

ci-scanner-bot: scan-report: 14 images flagged, severity: exposed_base64_auth (docker/config.json), first seen: 2026-03-20. Full report uploaded to https://redwood-sec/reports/1912345678

beth (product): Any customer impact or need for external notice?

maria (security): No evidence of external exposure so far; registry is internal and reads were limited to employees. We'll escalate if we detect external pulls. Treat as high priority internally.

olivia (eng-releases): Uploaded artifacts.csv with 14 tags and owners. Pinged owners to rebuild now.

jake (infra): Rotation complete for ci-pipeline SA. New keys pushed to Vault, old keys revoked at 2026-03-23T19:25:30Z. Registry tokens rotated and old tokens invalidated.

sam (sre): Forensics initial: only internal dev IPs accessed images. No customer infra pulls observed. Forensics report ETA ~2h.

maria (security): Action items recap:
- Owners: rebuild + redeploy images -> deadline 2026-03-24 23:59 UTC
- Eng-releases: patch pipeline to disable legacy cache and land PR by EOD
- Infra: confirm rotated tokens + share Vault paths in this thread
- SRE: finalize forensics and attach report

maria (security): I'll post a final incident summary after forensics. If you've completed your action, reply here with DONE + @owner.

olivia (eng-releases): DONE (images rebuilt and pushed by owners listed in CSV)

jake (infra): DONE (rotation confirmed, vault paths: secret/data/ci/credentials)
notes: no external pull evidence at initial triage
owners must rebuild images and disable legacy cache
